items.title: Kushner Meets With Hamas to Advance Trump’s Gaza Plan
items.summary: The president’s son-in-law met the Palestinian militant group’s leaders in Egypt, officials said. He will soon see Benjamin Netanyahu, the Israeli leader.

items.title: Kushner meets with Hamas on the Gaza road map ahead of talks with Netanyahu
items.summary: Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law, held a rare meeting with Hamas leadership Sunday in Egypt, in a new diplomatic effort to make progress in the stalled Gaza ceasefire.
